timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: We encrypt everything. Security problem solved?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Encryption is only as strong as the key management. The key is the crown jewel.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: HSM-backed storage. Azure Key Vault. Hardware protection plus access control and logging.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: For sensitive data, you. Customer-managed keys give you rotation and revocation control.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Yes. On a schedule, and after personnel or incident changes. Old keys must not linger.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: No. Separate keys per environment and data classification. Contain a compromise.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Least privilege, break-glass procedures, and log every key operation.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: What if I lose the key?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Key loss is data loss. Back up keys and test restore.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: So keys need more protection than the data?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: At least as much. The key opens everything the data protects.
